newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg's Arbed open to further synergies.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg's Arbed open to further synergies.

text.p: Luxembourg steel maker Arbed SA said on Tuesday it saw further restructuring in the steel sector in Europe and was itself open to further synergies with fellow steel makers.

Asked about the possibilities of ultimately becoming part of a big Benelux steel group, Arbed president Joseph Kinsch told a news conference on 1996 earnings that restructuring in Europe is certainly not finished.

"We did not wait for the German Thyssen/Krupp decision (to merge) to think of our future. We have always been an open group. Lots of collaboration already exists," he said, mentioning Belgian Cockerill Sambre and French Usinor-Sacilor.
"We are open to other synergies," he said.
